title: Custody handshake test vectors
description: Shared cross-impl test vectors for custody transfer. Vectors needed: (1) successful custody handshake (POST /msg/custody + 2.01 Created), (2) TTL budget rejection (5.03 ttl_insufficient), (3) storage full rejection (5.03 storage_full), (4) idempotent retransmission (same msg-id, second 2.01 without duplicate store), (5) custody chain: 3-hop forwarding sequence, (6) final delivery to recipient (POST /msg/inbox + 2.04). Place in test/vectors/. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1.
